title: Polynomial-time non-tautology verification
statement: Let $L$ be the language of binary strings $z$ for which there exists $i \in \mathbb{N}$ with $|z|=i+(i+1)$ such that the DNF formula decoded from the first $i$ bits of $z$ evaluates to false under the assignment given by the remaining $i+1$ bits, with variables beyond those bits assigned false. Then $L$ belongs to $\mathrm{P}$.
replaced:
The set of binary strings $z$ such that $|z| = i + (i + 1)$ for some $i$ and the DNF
decoded from the first $i$ bits of $z$ evaluates to false under the assignment reading
variable $v$ off the $v$-th of the remaining $i + 1$ bits (false beyond them) belongs
to $\mathrm{P}$.
